answers.text: The reply puts the fixes in priority order and says what needs a person
answers.evidence: The priority order is there: 'Fix before launch' (1-6), then 'Fix soon' (7-13), then 'In short: what to fix first'. But the only things it says it could not check are the two 'Ask the agency' code inferences ('not tested against a live system'). It names no WCAG checks that need a human (screen reader, manual review) and no testing with real residents or skimmers.

mapping.title: Double tap on 'Book this slot' cancels the booking while the page still says 'Booked'
mapping.reason: Nothing changes for 1.5 s, a second tap turns into 'Cancel booking', and the done page is still titled Booked with a reference. This is D09 exactly.

mapping.title: 'Few left' slots moved to the top, out of time order and above the Morning heading; focus/reading order differs
mapping.reason: Few-left slots are pulled to the front of the grid, out of time order and out of the focus and reading order (WCAG 1.3.2/2.4.3). The fix it gives is to remove order:-1.

mapping.title: Reference page doesn't show the day, slot time, vehicle or waste
mapping.reason: The done page is missing the day, the slot and the vehicle, which is D14.

mapping.title: Same-day slots that have already gone are offered, then refused at the last step
mapping.reason: Today's slots that have started (08:00) are shown as free and only refused after all the details are filled in. Its fix (no slots starting within 30 minutes) matches D06.

mapping.title: 5-minute hold never mentioned; expiry error has no link and the slot becomes a dash
mapping.reason: The hold runs out without being shown, the error is 'no longer available' and the summary's slot changes to a dash. This is D08.

mapping.title: Missing van/trailer permit only caught at the end, with no link back
mapping.reason: The permit is enforced only on the confirm page with no way back. The instructions put the confirm-page permit error under D07.

mapping.title: Permit number field shown for every vehicle, including cars (CSS overrides hidden)
mapping.reason: The reviewer saw it in the browser and names the cause: .field{display:flex} overrides hidden. Car drivers are shown a permit field they don't need and may think they need a permit or stop to get one. This is not one of the seeded defects.

mapping.title: For vans the permit field is revealed 1.2 s late and not announced
mapping.reason: This is the delayed permit field. The instructions assign it explicitly to D07.

mapping.title: No visible focus on slot buttons (injected .slot:focus{outline:0})
mapping.reason: A style the script injects removes the outline from the slot buttons, so keyboard users can't see where they are. This is D05.

mapping.title: 'Change slot' returns to Today instead of the chosen day
mapping.reason: 'Change slot' forgets the chosen day and opens on today, which is D12.

mapping.title: 'Few left' label contrast too low (3.0:1 light, 3.4:1 dark)
mapping.reason: The Few-left tag fails the 4.5:1 contrast needed for 16 px bold text. This is D03.

mapping.title: Slot grid overflows sideways at 360 px and below (and at 200% zoom)
mapping.reason: The script sets fixed column widths, so the page scrolls 14-15 px sideways at 360/320 px. Removing the resize handler fixes this and the zoom case, so it is D04.

mapping.title: Nothing visible while slots load; Next taps ignored
mapping.reason: The slot area is empty and silent for about a second and taps on Next do nothing. This is the wait itself, D01.

mapping.title: 'Arrive within your slot' only in a tooltip that doesn't work on phones
mapping.reason: The arrive-within guidance is shown only in a tooltip. The instructions put tooltip-only slot information under D13.

mapping.title: Vehicle-page error summary links point to non-focusable containers
mapping.reason: Tapping 'Choose the vehicle...' or 'Choose at least one kind of waste' moves neither focus nor view, so residents, keyboard users and screen-reader users can't get to the field that needs fixing. This is not seeded.

mapping.title: Waste hint stops being read out after an error
mapping.reason: Screen-reader users lose the hint at the moment they are correcting an error, so they can't tell what is expected. This is not seeded.

mapping.title: Vehicle choice would be better as radio buttons than toggle buttons
mapping.reason: It is a design preference ('would work better') and names no harm to residents.

mapping.title: Registration field should auto-capitalise and turn off spellcheck
mapping.reason: On a phone, autocorrect and lower-case entry can change a number plate as it is typed, and the gate checks the vehicle. Typing it is harder and errors are more likely. This is not seeded.

mapping.title: Only way to cancel is 'Call on a weekday' though the centre opens at weekends
mapping.reason: A resident who can't make a weekend slot can't cancel it when it matters. The slot is wasted and the resident has no way out. This is not seeded.

mapping.title: Dark-mode colours set by the script, so default colours show first if it is slow or fails
mapping.reason: It is speculative and depends on the script being slow or failing. It names no harm to booking beyond a brief flash of default colours.

mapping.title: 'Today' and the quick-day buttons are fixed at 12 October 2026
mapping.reason: The scenario fixes today as Monday 12 October (see D06), so this is the fixture's clock. It is an inference about the build that the review did not test, not a problem residents meet in the flow.

mapping.title: No booking system behind the site; availability and reference generated in the browser
mapping.reason: It is a code-reading guess about whether this is a demo build or the production one. It is not a usability problem in the booking flow residents use.
